name: zlib
description: Search, download, and manage Z-Library ebooks with the zlib CLI

interface.shortDescription: Search, download, organize, and deliver ebooks with the zlib CLI
interface.longDescription: Search and download Z-Library ebooks, browse saved books and recommendations, inspect download history and account quota, look up and edit local ebook metadata, import books to WeRead, and send files to Kindle through SMTP. Requires the zlib CLI. GitHub: https://github.com/jerryemc/zlib-kimi
